look.why: A warm dry-savanna terracotta orange that contrasts with the rugged charcoal-grey scales of Komodo Island.

size.measure: total length 2–3 m from snout to tail tip (heaviest living lizard)

habitat.text: Dry tropical savannas, monsoon forests, and coastal scrublands on Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and Gili Motang in Indonesia.

diet.text: Deer, wild pigs, water buffalo, carrion, and smaller reptiles, hunted with serrated teeth and venom glands.

facts.text: The heaviest living lizard on Earth, capable of eating up to 80 percent of its body weight in a single meal.
Uses a deeply forked yellow tongue to sample airborne scent molecules from up to 4 km away.
